strings.facts.only: This report states facts about bytes. It does not decide whether a recording was altered before it was seen, and no line in it should be read as such a decision.
strings.not.an.examination: This is not an authentication examination.
strings.inspection.moov.first: The movie box precedes the media data, which is how the reference camera writes its files.
strings.inspection.moov.last: The movie box follows the media data. The reference camera writes it first; a file from that camera laid out this way passed through another program. Other recorders write this layout themselves.
strings.inspection.moov.none: The file has no media data box.
strings.inspection.tail: The file ends with {bytes} byte(s) that do not read as a box or belong to a box declaring more than the file holds. A recorder that pre-allocates its files leaves such a tail, and so does one that lost power.
strings.inspection.vendor.present: {count} vendor box(es) preserved as bytes, not interpreted: {list}.
strings.inspection.vendor.absent: No vendor box is present. A recording from the reference camera carries two; a file from that camera without them passed through another program. Other recorders write none.
strings.inspection.user.data.standard: {count} user-data box(es) of a type the file format defines, preserved as bytes, not interpreted: {list}. A common muxer writes such a box; it is not a recorder's.
strings.inspection.default.tracks: {count} video tracks are marked as the default, which is why players disagree about which one to show.
strings.integrity.file.identical: The file is identical, byte for byte, to the one the manifest was made from.
strings.integrity.file.differs: The file differs from the one the manifest was made from: recorded {recorded}, observed {observed}.
strings.integrity.file.not.recorded: The manifest records no whole-file digest, so the file as a whole was not compared.
strings.integrity.track.identical: Track {index}: the stored samples are identical to those the manifest records.
strings.integrity.track.differs: Track {index}: the stored samples differ from those the manifest records.
strings.integrity.track.not.recorded: Track {index}: the manifest records no fingerprint, so the samples were not compared.
strings.integrity.track.not.checkable: Track {index}: the samples could not be compared: {reason}.
strings.integrity.track.missing: Track {index}: the manifest records a track the file does not have.
strings.integrity.vendor.identical: Vendor box {kind} at {location}: identical to the bytes the manifest records.
strings.integrity.vendor.differs: Vendor box {kind} at {location}: differs from the bytes the manifest records.
strings.integrity.vendor.absent: Vendor box {kind} at {location}: recorded in the manifest and absent from the file.
strings.integrity.vendor.unexpected: Vendor box {kind} at {location}: present in the file and not recorded in the manifest.
strings.integrity.structure.identical: The container structure matches the one the manifest records.
strings.integrity.structure.differs: The container structure differs from the one the manifest records.
strings.structure.rewrite.none: No sign of rewriting was found in the container structure. This is not an authentication examination.
strings.structure.rewrite.some: The container structure shows {count} sign(s) that another program wrote this file:
strings.structure.sign.moov.after.mdat: the movie box follows the media data
strings.structure.sign.encoder.tag: the encoder tag {tag} belongs to another program
strings.structure.sign.single.video: one video track where a sibling recording has two
strings.structure.sign.vendor.absent: the vendor boxes a recording from this camera carries are absent
strings.structure.sign.resolution.capped: the resolution {width} by {height} is below what this camera records
strings.structure.unknown.layout: The file does not follow a naming grammar this product knows, so no comparison with a camera's layout was made.
strings.time.no.later.than: By {clock}, this recording dates from no later than {value}.
strings.time.container.clock.note: The container clock is written by the recorder into a field defined as UTC; the reference recorder writes local time there, and consecutive files share one value, so it is a session clock rather than a capture time.
strings.time.file.name.note: The file name carries a local time with no zone, written by the recorder at the start of the file.
strings.time.satellite.clock.note: The satellite clock is UTC from the receiver, one sentence per second.
strings.time.system.clock.note: The system clock of the machine that produced this manifest, read as UTC.
strings.time.disagreement: The clocks disagree: {list}. None of them is taken as the capture time.
strings.fingerprint.track: Track {index} fingerprint ({version}): {digest} over {count} samples and {bytes} bytes, prefix width {width}.
strings.fingerprint.configuration: Track {index} decoder configuration ({box}): {digest}, reproducible with the reference script.
strings.fingerprint.stream: Track {index} elementary stream ({rule}): {digest} over {bytes} bytes, reproducible with the documented command.
strings.fingerprint.file: Whole file: {digest} over {bytes} bytes, reproducible with a digest utility.
strings.scan.paired: {front} and {rear}: two files, one per camera, matched by name.
strings.scan.unpaired: {name}: named as one camera of a pair; its counterpart was not found.
strings.scan.not.recognised: {name}: a container holding {count} video track(s), under a name that fits no recorder's grammar this product knows.
strings.scan.skipped: {count} file(s) were not opened, because their extension is not one a recording carries.
strings.export.written: {name}: {class}, {bytes} bytes, {count} track(s). The coded samples were copied byte for byte and the movie box precedes the media data.
strings.export.track: Track {output} is track {source} of {name}: {samples} samples, {bytes} bytes, fingerprint identical to the source.
strings.export.preserved: {count} box(es) carried across as bytes, not interpreted: {list}.
strings.export.preserved.none: No recorder box was carried across, because the source holds none or the plan left them out.
strings.export.references.dropped: {count} track reference(s) named a track this file does not hold and were left out, so nothing here refers to a track that is not here.
strings.export.credentials.left.out: The source carried Content Credentials, which are bound to the bytes of the file they were written into and would not hold in this one; they were left out. Sign this export to give it its own.
strings.export.manifest: The manifest of this file is at {path}; it records the sources and their fingerprints.
strings.export.faces: This export shows faces, number plates, and the time and position the recorder wrote into the picture. Sharing it publicly may be subject to data-protection rules; the originals stay on this device.
strings.sign.embedded: {name}: Content Credentials embedded in the file, signed as {signer} ({algorithm}).
strings.sign.sidecar: {name}: Content Credentials written beside the file at {path}, signed as {signer} ({algorithm}); the file itself was not touched.
strings.sign.ephemeral: The credential was generated for this run and is on no trust list, so a validator shows an unknown signer. Sign with a held credential before anything leaves this device.
strings.sign.time: A time stamp from {authority} is inside the signature.
strings.sign.time.none: No time-stamping authority was asked, so the signature carries no time.
strings.credentials.embedded: Content Credentials embedded in the file, signed as {signer} ({algorithm}), generated by {generator}.
strings.credentials.sidecar: Content Credentials beside the file at {path}, signed as {signer} ({algorithm}), generated by {generator}.
strings.credentials.none: No Content Credentials are embedded in the file or beside it.
strings.credentials.state.on.list: The signature and the binding to the file hold, and the signer's certificate chains to the Content Credentials trust list.
strings.credentials.state.not.on.list: The signature and the binding to the file hold. The signer's certificate chains to no trust list, so a validator shows an unknown signer.
strings.credentials.state.invalid: The signature or the binding to the file does not hold: {codes}.
strings.credentials.time: A time-stamping authority attested {time}: the signature existed no later than that instant (clock: the authority's).
strings.credentials.time.none: The signature carries no time stamp, so nothing here says when it was made.
strings.credentials.facts.match: The signed facts are an adiungere manifest for {name}, and every track fingerprint in them is the file's.
strings.credentials.facts.differ: The signed facts are an adiungere manifest for {name}, and {count} track(s) in them do not carry the fingerprints this file has.
strings.credentials.facts.none: The signed facts are not an adiungere manifest this version reads.
strings.stamp.written: {name}: a time-stamp token from {authority} was written to {path}. The file existed no later than {time} (clock: the authority's).
strings.stamp.token: A time-stamp token at {path} names this manifest: it existed no later than {time} (clock: the authority's; the authority's chain was not checked against a trust list).
strings.stamp.token.mismatch: The time-stamp token at {path} does not name this manifest: {reason}.
